body.fallback: Draft fictional venue comparison — not independently verified. This view reads the saved comparison revision to which it is bound; it does not copy venue facts or change the table. Interactive defaults: maximum hire budget £300, minimum capacity 70 people, step-free required. Based on the accepted corrections described by you, no venue should qualify at these defaults; increasing the budget to £350 should allow comparison of eligible options. The interactive count must be computed from the saved data, not this description. When scripting is unavailable, reopen the saved comparison table and compare hire cost, capacity, step-free access, travel minutes and your notes against these criteria. Refresh saved data re-reads this exact bound revision, not a newer replacement. If access is refused or stale, the view displays an error; a new revision requires a new binding. Controls are temporary and never save edits, book venues or access the internet. Human review note: keep this saved explorer as a draft; no booking is authorized.
